About.title: One place for the lifestyle you keep starting over.
About.lead: NAMAT began with a simple frustration: everything that makes a person healthier in Oman already exists — the kitchens, the studios, the dietitians, the small honest brands. It is just scattered across ten apps and twenty accounts.
About.b1Body: One connected journey. Discover what fits you, book it, and keep track of it — without starting from zero every few months.
About.b2Body: Not a clinic and not a diagnosis. NAMAT connects you to qualified people and good places. The decisions stay yours.
About.b3Body: Muscat first, then the rest of Oman, then the GCC — carrying our partners with us.
About.v1Body: Omani businesses lead the marketplace, not global chains.
About.v2Body: Clear prices, no hidden renewal, no manipulation.
About.v3Body: Personalization you can see, change and switch off.
